**Main “Friends” cast – their first on‑screen (credited) acting role**

| Actor | Debut role (year) | Production | Character |
|-------|-------------------|------------|-----------|
| **Jennifer Aniston** | *Leprechaun* (1993) | Feature film (directed by Mark Jones) | **Megan** – the teenage babysitter who becomes the leprechaun’s first victim |
| **Courteney Cox** | *Masters of the Universe* (1987) | Feature film (the live‑action adaptation of the He‑Man toy line) | **Daphne** – a member of the heroic “Warriors” who helps He‑Man defeat Skeletor |
| **Lisa Kudrow** | *Maid to Order* (1992) | Feature film (comedy starring Ally Sheedy) | **Poppy** – a quirky, aspiring actress who works as a maid in a Hollywood celebrity’s house |
| **Matt LeBlanc** | *TV 101* (1989) – “The Outbreak” (Season 1, Episode 1) | Television drama (one‑hour series about a high‑school journalism class) | **Guy** – a student who appears in the pilot’s classroom scene |
| **Matthew Perry** | *A Night in the Life of Jimmy Reardon* (1988) | Feature film (based on the novel by William Richert) | **Jimmy Reardon** – the title character’s best friend (the role is credited as “Jimmy’s Friend”) |
| **David Schwimmer** | *The Wonder Years* (1989) – “The Girl” (Season 2, Episode 14) | Television series (coming‑of‑age dramedy) | **Tommy** – a classmate who appears briefly in the episode’s school‑yard scene |

**Notes**

* The dates reflect the year the project was released (or first aired, for TV).  
* For a few of the cast members the very first on‑screen credit was a small guest spot on a television series; their first *major* or *lead* role came later (e.g., Courteney Cox’s breakout TV role was on *Family Ties* the same year as her film debut).  
* All six actors went on to become household names thanks to “Friends,” but each of the entries above marks the earliest professional acting credit that is listed in their filmographies.
